product.description: Wallbarn's Universal  Extra adjustable pedestal range is suitable for both paving and decking. They are particularly ideal for porcelain tiles on flat roofs and podiums. Even flat roofs are built to a small fall to allow adequate drainage. They also come with an integrated acoustic shim on the headpiece. These pedestals have the heights marked out every 10mm on the side of stems, so users can see at a glance the exact height they are adjusting to without having to constantly re-measure. Each EXTRA pedestal comes complete with an extension shank which clicks into the baseplate. product.name: Wallbarn TD Minipad Adjustable Support Pad
product.description: The TD Minipad Adjustable Support Pad by Wallbarn is an effective solution for your suspended timber decking system. product.name: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain Outlet
product.description: Available in different lengths and diameters, this perforated roof drain outlet from Wallbarn is made of flexible and strong TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer). It works to add a waterproof element to drainage holes on both balconies and roofs that are already equipped with bituminous waterproofing membranes. With resilience to weathering and UV rays, this outlet can withstand temperature changes up to 120°C and resist brittleness in lower temperatures.Where holes are made in concrete decks, this outlet is easily installed after a layer of waterproof membrane and then coated with a second layer on top of the flange - which has a perforated edge for the membrane to settle in for a secure and sturdy bond. The 240mm shank fits into an HDPE (High-density polyethylene) pipe snuggly and is slightly coned to ease the fit and provide additional stability. Water is prevented from travelling back up thanks to the two rings that emulate a drain tap, and the serrated area allows for a drain guard to join the system.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain OutletMade from TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer) for durability, resilience, and waterproofingInstalled alongside two layers of a waterproofing membranePerforated flange to help bondingConed shank with serrated area to ease installation and allow for drain guardsUV stable and able to withstand high (120°C) and low temperatures.Compatible with SBS (Styrene Butadiene Styrene) and APP (Atactic Polypropylene Membrane) membranes, such as built-up (felt), hot melt, mastic asphalt, and other liquid-applied membranes.Please note: Do not allow direct contact with concrete as this can allow water to find its way beneath the outlet and cause damage.Assure that a layer of membrane is fully bonded to the outlet flange and the first layer for completely watertight bonds.
product.variant_name: Roofdrain Outlet (TPE) Perforated 600mm High - 80mm Diameter

product.name: Wallbarn BALANCE Adjustable Pedestal
product.description: Ideal for both decking and paving installations, this BALANCE pedestal from Wallbarn has self-levelling headpieces that provide increased scope and flexibility and accommodate any differences in your deck’s surface beneath the pedestal.Available in a range of height options from 25mm up to 395mm, this BALANCE pedestal adjusts any unevenness that can occur due to deck ridges and blemishes. Hiding water pipes, cables and drainage outlets to improve aesthetic integrity, this BALANCE pedestal can enhance your building’s footprint. It can also be used in collaboration with cross spacers, shims, slope correctors and various other accessories. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn BALANCE Adjustable PedestalTime-saving installation processHides unsightly pipework and cablesPrevents slippery surfaces from pooled waterFixes uneven surfacesAvailable in a range of heightsVersatile across decking and paving applicationsTo save time during installation, the telescopic stem can be twisted by hand and helps you to create a completely flat upper surface. As a suspended system, the weight of the decking or slab keeps everything positioned correctly in place. Rainwater can easily drain and run between and underneath to minimise slippery surfaces and avoid pooling.Thanks to the headpiece and lugs (fins), this BALANCE pedestal is straightforward to apply to decking and paving. They ensure a quicker and stronger installation, prevent tilting and create uniform lines for drainage.Please note: For extra height, BALANCE EXTRA pedestals are available and provide 100mm up to 395mm in just three different products.

product.name: Wallbarn TPE Extension Shank
product.description:
Wallbarn extension shanks are designed to fix up with the drainage outlets to increase the reach into the parapet wall or drainage channel.
Often the ducts and channels will have to pass through a long run of concrete before reaching a suitable area to install the HDPE drainpipe, so an extension of a fully waterproof sealed connector will be required. These extension shanks are specially designed to fit in with the full range of Wallbarn circular outlets.
They are made from TPE but can still be used with EPDM and PVC outlets. They are manufactured to a slight cone shape, so the end of the circular outlet slots inside the top of the extension shank. The two membranes are bonded together using silicone adhesive.
Please note: Installers of PVC waterproofing systems should always inform waterproofing manufacturer before using these two materials together in order check the status of the warranty.

product.name: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable Pedestal
product.description: The specially designed Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA adjustable pedestals are ideal for decking and paving projects. The self-levelling headpieces have been developed to give extra scope and flexibility, so differences are accommodated within the surface beneath the pedestal. The BALANCE also helps alleviate blemishes and ridges in the sub-deck or changes in the thickness of your paving slabs which makes the upper surface uneven.Whereas BALANCE pedestals are available in heights from 25mm up to 395mm, BALANCE EXTRA pedestals give an extended height range from 100mm up to 395mm in just three different products.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable PedestalIdeal for decking and pavingEasier and faster than old fashioned methodsSpecially designed to give extra scope and flexibilityHeight: 222mm - 392mm, 137mm - 227mm, 97mm - 147mmType: AdjustableThis suspended system uses the weight of the slab or decking to hold everything into place. Rainwater runs between and underneath, so there is no standing water left on the surface of your floor. This dramatically reduces the risk of slipping and causing serious injury.You can hide unsightly objects such as cables, water pipes and drainage outlets underneath the paving slabs as well, improving the aesthetics of your floor.Decking ApplicationsWhen used with timber decking systems, the lugs(fins) are set out towards the edges of the headpiece to give a 55mm gap between each one. This allows a timber joist to fit between the lugs (fins), and then decking boards are can be fixed to the joist frame. Installers are able to create decking surfaces onto structural decks much faster by adjusting the height of pedestals rather than cutting furrings.Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece design has four positioning lugs (fins) laid out in a crucifix formation set towards the edges of the headpiece. The design means that it robust, stable and durable. The headpiece has separate parts that allow up to 5% or 2.86 degrees of slope correction in all directions. This allows smooth movement and positioning of the paving slab. Slips and sharp tilting are avoided owing to the superior design and solid manufacture. The lugs (fins) separate paving slabs and tiles on the headpiece to allow sufficient drainage between slabs, which create a uniform paving line, so the slabs are laid entirely straight. A rubber anti-shock pad can slot onto the headpiece to give a better grip to the slab and help insulate against vibration and noise travelling through to the deck beneath.Please note: Shims, slope correctors, cross spacers and other accessories can also be used with the BALANCE Pedestals.
product.variant_name: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable Paving Pedestal - 97mm to 147mm

product.name: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking Pedestal
product.description: Wallbarn's Mega Balance Self-Levelling Pedestals are an easy-to-install four-in-one solution that you can use in various applications, thanks to its ingenious headpiece design that supports not only decking joists and bearers but also paving slabs and tiles.With a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mm, this heavy-duty suspended system means the weight of the paving slabs or tiles ballasts themselves securely into position. Each pedestal is made from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillers, which will provide long-term durability and performance. They have even been laboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking PedestalAn easy-to-install pedestal that supports both decking boards and paving slabs/tilesA self-levelling and fixed head pedestal all in oneHas a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mmSelf-levelling headpiece moves up to 5% or 2.86° in all directionsYou can adjust your pedestals slightly even after a project has been completed, saving on labour and improving health and safetyThe ‘grey nut’ can be pressed into the centre of the headpiece to lock the self-levelling mechanism should installers require fixed headsThe headpiece comes with an integrated rubber anti-shock pad, which clicks into place to give a better grip and improves vibration and noise insulationMade from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillersLaboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures1 black nut for every four units purchased.While the headpiece is self-levelling as standard, by using the 'grey nut', the head can be locked rigid within the same unit. If you need to adjust the height of your pedestals, you can do this using the 'yellow' and 'silver' key tools, even on a completed paving project, without having to lift and remove any of the slabs.For Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece incorporates 4 x 4mm wide positioning lugs (fins) integrated with the headpiece, helping to create a uniform paving line for your slabs and tiles. Not only does it aid the overall aesthetic of your paving, but with the headpiece’s lugs separating your tiles, this allows for improved drainage. To install, simply lay the paving slab or tile onto one segment of the headpiece so four corners of your paving slabs or tiles rest on each headpiece. This will ensure four pedestals support each corner of a slab or tile, providing stable and secure support. For Decking ApplicationsThe four positioning lugs on the self-levelling headpiece are set 55mm apart so a 50mm wide joist/bearer can be loose-laid between them easily. It is loose-laid rather than mechanically fixed in case of expansion or movement, which can cause differences between the structure beneath and the decking over time. The lugs are high enough to house the joists securely, giving you flexibility in your decking project. When laying your decking, the joists/bearers should be cross-fitted together to form a secure framework. The upper surface decking boards can then be mechanically fixed to the joist frame according to the specification and assembly instructions of the deck board supplier. Standards & CertificationFire Classification: EUROCLASS E according to EN 13501-1-2009Please note: You will only receive 1 black nut for every four units purchased. Additional black Nuts can be purchased.In decking applications, there is no need to cut furrings as the pedestals are adjusted in height to create a flat frame level.The headpiece is self-levelling as standard. Installers may or may not wish to click the grey nut into the headpiece to lock the head, depending on the characteristics of the decking project.There are cut lines on the underside of the baseplates should installers need to pave directly up to walls or parapets - do not cut bases beyond these cut lines.Special CLASS B1 (EN 13501-1-2009) rated pedestals can be manufactured upon request.

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Naylor's land drain pipe filter sock geotextile is a great addition to pipe systems. Particularly in sandy and silty soil conditions.A special knit fabric, this sock allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe, then subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with water. The fabric prevents larger soil particles from passing through the fabric, causing a bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. An example of this is granular backfill materials.  The bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials and immediately surrounds the perforated drainage pipe.Features & Benefits: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock GeotextileSuitable for sandy and silty soil conditionsKnit fabricPrevents large soil particles from passing throughAllows fine soil particles to pass through

product.name: Naylor Pre-Loaded Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description:
The specially knit fabric allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe that are subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with the water. The remaining larger soil particles that are blocked from passing through the fabric, bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. Like granular backfill materials, the bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials immediately surrounding the perforated drainage pipe. It is particularly suited for use in sandy and silty soil conditions.

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Designed to complement Naylor Land Drain Pipes, this 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile is made from a specially knit fabric, which offers a unique solution by allowing ultra-fine soil particles to effortlessly flow through, joining the perforated pipe. As water flows, these fine particles are efficiently carried away, ensuring optimal drainage performance. What's more, this Filter Sock Geotextile also plays a crucial role in retaining larger soil particles. These particles, unable to pass through the fabric, create a bridging effect on its outer surface. This not only provides additional structural support but also enhances the permeability of the surrounding native backfill materials, mimicking the benefits of granular backfill. This geotextile is especially well-suited for sand and silty soil conditions. product.description: Designed to create a branch from a surface water drainage main line at a 45° angle, JFC Manufacturing's Twinwall drain pipe Y unequal branch is a triple socket section manufactured from HDPE plastic. Better yet, the modern design means that unlike traditional single-wall pipes it will prevent slit accumulation. product.name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe Surface Water Drainage Double Socket Bend
product.description:
HDPE double socket twinwall bends. For use with twinwall pipe to create a rigid bends. If installed with 2 sealing rings a watertight system can be achieved.
For surface water applications only. Complies with HAPAS BBA.
Twin Wall drainage pipe is made from HDPE plastic and is available from 100mm to 3000mm diameters. Manufactured by a twin extrusion process in which two layers are simultaneously extruded, one inside the other and heat welded together in one continuous process. The outer wall is corrugated providing excellent structural strength which reduces the possibility of on-site damage. The inner wall has a smooth seamless finish to assist hydraulic flow. This design, unlike traditional single-wall pipe prevents silt accumulation.
Benefits of Twin Wall include:

Lightweight 6 metre long lengths
Strong (Twin Walled & corrugated)
Smooth inner wall for increased flow capacity
Resistant to naturally occuring chemicals
Can be installed at depths from 0.5 to 10 metres
BBA and HAPAS Roads & Bridges Agrément Certificate No. 02/H069
Reduced plant & labour costs
Faster installation as 6 metre lengths mean fewer joints
Elimination of waste compared to traditional pipe
Pipe is easily cut to size requirements on site
A full range of bends of all angles & both equal & unequal junctions are also available

product.name: Marsh Whisspurr W-AVR Acoustic Vibration Reduction Unit
product.description:
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reaction (AVR) unit has been designed to limit noise levels and vibrations from diaphragm compressors used in the water and wastewater treatment sectors.
Suitable for all types of compressor including; Bibus Secoh, Nitto and Charles Austen, the Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit is easily fitted inline between the compressor and air diffuser. If space permits, the Marsh Whisspurr unit should be fitted as close as possible to the compressor – preferably, inside the sewage treatment plant.
Please note, the Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit is chemically sealed and bolted shut, which creates a pressure vacuum when in operation. Any tampering, breaking of the seal, or removal of any bolts will invalidate the warranty and will prevent the unit from working effectively. This unit is also not suitable for side channel blowers.
What are the benefits of the Marsh Whisppurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit?
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit’s innovative design ensures that any noise pollution emanating from the compressor unit is dramatically reduced without hindering the overall performance of the treatment system. Rural areas, where continuous noise is a nuisance, particularly benefits from AVR unit’s noise and vibration reduction qualities.
Available in four standard sizes, the corrosion free Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit does not require any electrics and can be easily installed into existing wastewater and water treatment systems.
Features and Benefits

Innovative UK design (patent pending).
Significantly reduces compressor volume and vibration without reducing in air pressure from the compressor.
No increase in back pressure to the compressor.
The unit contains no moving parts and requires no electrics.
Can be easily retrofitted to existing compressors.
Hose tail is 20mm standard.
Ideal for rural areas where noise pollution is a nuisance.
Available in four standard sizes.
Manufactured from resin and glass polymer, making the unit corrosion free and invulnerable to warm/humid conditions.
Unit is dark green as standard.

Specification
Overall unit width: 142mm
Overall unit height (excluding hose tail):200mm240mm350mm450mm
Material (unit): Resin and Glass Polymer
Material (hose tail connections): Brass with Stainless Steel nuts and bolts.
Colour: Dark Green

product.name: Marsh Cesspool Cesspit Tank
product.description:
The Marsh cesspool cesspit tank is a covered, watertight unit for storing raw household sewage. It has no outlet and relies on road transport for the removal of raw sewage. No biological treatment is involved.

Heavy duty shell as standard to enable installation in all ground conditions
Integral lifting eyes for improved on-site handling
Unique ‘keying-in’ lip to assist anchoring into granular or concrete surround

Modern environmental regulations either discourage or ban the use of cesspools (Cesspools are not permitted in Scotland), and instead connections to municipal sewage systems or package sewage treatment plants are encouraged or required.In many countries, planning and development regulations for the protection of the environment prevent home-owners who live close to rivers and environmentally sensitive areas from installing a cesspit or septic system, requiring a sewage treatment plant instead.
Please note, whoever empties your cesspool should be a registered Waste Carrier and hold a current discharge licence from the local water authority.

product.name: Marsh Portapurra Temporary Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The portable and compact Portapura sewage treatment tank from Marsh Industries has been specifically designed for temporary accommodation (caravans/travel homes), site offices, site toilets and workshops. The Portapura can be installed above or below ground and treats domestic wastewater to a level that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard.
What are the benefits of choosing Marsh Portapura?
This compact and portable sewage treatment tank is designed specifically for temporary buildings. Design objectives included performance, running costs, installation, transport and storage, making the Portapura the logical choice for sites where temporary buildings are required.
The Portapura’s compact design provides quick and easy installation (where below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours) with minimum visual impact on the surrounding landscape as well as simple and safe access for maintenance and cleaning.  Systems can be installed above ground and removed/stored when not in use.
The cost of installing and running the Portapura is minimal when compared to larger, commercial systems making it one of the more cost-effective sewage treatment tanks on the market.
Another benefit of choosing the Portapura sewage treatment tank is its impact on the environment. Being CE?approved to BS EN 12566 with an ammonia result that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard means the Portapura is well within discharge consent requirements.
Technical

Available in three sizes - 2, 3 or 5 person units (gravity or pumped outlet)
Compact, lightweight construction - No heavy plant required
Portable
Cost effective installation - Below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours
Outstanding treatment efficiency - 14:19:0.7mg/ltr (BOD:Suspended solids:Ammonia)
Near silent air compressor - Ensures minimal running, maintenance and servicing costs
Electrical consumption: 1.8kWh/d - Equivalent to the daily use of a lightbulb
CE?approved to BS?EN 12566
Fire resistance tested in accordance with EN ISO 11925-2:210
Tested for structural integrity in accordance with EN ISO 179-1/1eA
Neck extensions are available for deeper installations

Do not install a Portapura treatment plant in water logged or uneven ground.
Do not remove the covers of the Portapura, or access the unit in any way, without firstly isolating the mains power.

Pumped outlets available

product.name: Marsh:Standard Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants are a cost-effective way of treating sewage and wastewater in an off-mains area. For large residential, commercial and industrial sites, including leisure sites, Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants will provide biological processing for effluent until it’s of a quality well within the British Water effluent standard.
This sewage treatment plant will provide effluent treatment for up to 85 people. Manufactured in the UK, the tank is made from GRP virgin unfilled resin to provide a durable and structurally secure tank that has consistent wall thickness and no fillers in the material. Built this way in part as a safety feature, Marsh:Standard plants also have turret guards and failure alarms for extra peace of mind.
A low energy compressor and high specification bacteria keep the Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plant running smoothly as the bacteria along with membrane diffusers ensure the circulation of effluent so that it’s all treated. The low energy compressor minimises running costs whilst the system needs minimal maintenance as the system itself has no moving parts.
Approved to BS12566, the heavy duty shell provides a long life for Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants. Alarms and 600mm lockable manhole covers are as standard.

product.name: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant is an effective solution for sewage treatment, designed to accommodate areas where a natural gravity flow is not feasible. By opting for a pumped treatment plant, the system will efficiently direct effluent to higher levels, ensuring an economical and environmentally friendly operation.
When installed correctly, the Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant operates virtually odour-free and near-silently, also offering a discreet design that will not create eyesores in your garden or outdoor spaces. It is recommended Ensign plants are positioned at a minimum distance of seven metres from a dwelling or ten metres from a stream.
Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantAn effective and environmentally friendly pumped solution for sewage treatment in areas without gravity flowEfficiently directs effluent to higher levels using a pumpDiscrete design, virtually odour-free and operates near-silentlyFeatures lifting eyes for easy unloading and self-levelling on the base for easy installationUnique pipe connections for efficient and cost-effective installationTreats effluent to British and European Standards25-year structural guarantee
Featuring lifting eyes, this treatment plant facilitates quick and safe unloading, while its self-levelling capability on the base ensures ease of installation. The unique and innovative pipe connections enable efficient and cost-effective installation, catering to various property sizes.
The Ensign range of sewage treatment plants excels in treating final effluent to both British and European Standards, meeting national consent standards for discharge into watercourses. Manufactured with 100% virgin resin, excluding chalk fillers, this plant prioritises sustainability. It has undergone rigorous testing, adhering to the highest European testing standard, EN12566:3-2005, enabling direct discharge to ditches, watercourses, or percolation beds.
Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 12566 3-2005
Please note: External Cabinet as standard. Fitted with an internal pumped outlet and will do a max head of 3m and 50m pumped distance. Outlet is 32mm MDPE.

product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe
product.description: This Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe is part of a sturdy and flexible dry-jointed pipework system that is easy to install and suited to various applications. It is lightweight yet durable, making it resistant to accidental external damage and vandalism, and eco-friendly with a recyclable cast iron structure.With a choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings, the complete soil and waste pipework system covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection. It is compatible with rainwater installations alongside Harmer Roof Outlets with pipes in lengths of 3m and diameters ranging from 50mm to 400mm. You can construct your system using the twin screw couplings. Socketless fixing between pipe and fittings is easy but secure without special installation equipment.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain PipeLightweight but strong cast ironHigh tensile strengthEasily assembled with socketless fixingResilient primer and epoxy coatings for low maintenanceRecyclable after useSystem suited to various applicationsThe pipes and fittings from this system are crafted from grey iron to DIN 1691 (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15), while the couplings feature stainless steel and ductile cast iron constructions. The pipes are coated with a primer (minimum thickness of 40 µm) on their exteriors and an epoxy coating (minimum thickness of 120 µm) on their interiors. Fittings, however, are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy coating (minimum thickness 60 µm). These epoxy coatings mean that pipes and fittings will only require minimal maintenance during their service life.High in tensile strength and non-combustible to prevent the need for fire protection collars, Harmer SML stands as a cutting-edge cast iron technology, with BBA certification, full compliance with BS EN 877, Kitemark certification, and CE Mark conformity.Standards & CertificationMeets British and European Standards: BS EN 877 and BS EN 14366; 2004 for excellent noise attenuationCertification: BBA Agrément certifiedCE Mark: European product conformity to harmonised standard BS EN 877 in accordance with Construction Products Regulation 2013Kitemark Certification: in accordance with BS EN877
